notes: Quality per release — REQ-032, AC-3. Append-only, committed, one entry per gated release.
Committed rather than kept in a dashboard for one reason: a threshold change and the results it was applied
to then appear in the same history. `git log -p evals/` shows the numbers, the limits they were judged
against, and any override with its actor and reason, in one place, without a service to keep running.
Each entry stores the thresholds in force for that release. So a reviewer reading a later entry against an
